data.title: WordPress development services
paragraphs: Content Cucumber and Evrig have teamed up to bring you world class WordPress sites from ideation to launch and everything in between.

The traditional agency left content to "someone" and the content company left the development work to someone else. With one team, the writer and the developer sit in the same call from the start. The page structure, the copy, and the code get decided together, and nothing falls into the gap between two vendors.
People plan the site and write the pages, AI speeds up the build, and your team gets a site it can edit without calling a developer.

Brent Peterson and Vijay Golani have worked together for nearly 20 years. Vijay is a two-time Magento Master, Evrig is a Hyva Gold Partner with Adobe Commerce certifications, and Content Cucumber brings 40+ human writers to every build.
WordPress is one of the platforms we build on, and the CMS development page covers the rest. We have teams in Chicago, Minneapolis and Hawaii.

items.question: How much does it cost to hire a WordPress developer?
items.answer: With Content Cucumber and Evrig, WordPress builds start at $500, and the written estimate you get after a short call sets the price before work begins. The final number depends on page count, custom design, and integrations.

items.question: Is WordPress outdated in 2026?
items.answer: No, WordPress still runs a large share of the web, has a big plugin ecosystem, and keeps getting updates. WordPress fits teams that publish often and want control over their site.

items.question: Why are some businesses moving away from WordPress?
items.answer: Some teams want a faster static site, and others want the site inside their CRM. We build on Astro and HubSpot CMS as well, so the recommendation on your call comes from what fits your team. See the CMS development page for the other platforms.

items.question: Can you move my site to WordPress?
items.answer: Yes. We move sites from Drupal, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, and custom builds, with content, redirects, and search rankings carried over and a parity check before launch.

items.question: Do you offer WordPress maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. Monthly support plans cover updates, security patches, and content changes, handled by the team that built the site.

items.question: Who does the development work?
items.answer: Evrig, our development partner, with an office in Northeast Minneapolis and developers in Ahmedabad, India. Content Cucumber runs the project and writes the pages, so you have one US point of contact.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Minneapolis and Chicago?
items.answer: Yes. Businesses in the Twin Cities and the Chicago area can meet us in person, and businesses everywhere else work with us over video with the same team and the same process.
